subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous runtime-object helpers that share no single owner: struct zero-init and CPU/memory capability detection used by render/UI global init, cube-map MAS file loading and its file-handle/table cleanup, a network audio stream receiver with a mode state machine, path/buffer resolution helpers behind FilePathNameLookup, a timed render-tree vertex projection updater, a config-key token parser, and generic allocation/cleanup utilities. Ownership of most objects is UNKNOWN; the two DERIVED class identities (CubeMapMasFileLoader, NetworkAudioReceiver) are the only owners the packet names.

summary: Twenty functions grouped by evidence into six candidate classes plus unowned helpers. CubeMapMasFileLoader (0x0055FBE0, 0x0055FC40, 0x0055FE30, 0x00560230) shares one layout: magic header at base, file handle at +0x10, filename buffer at +0x14, entry count at +0x118, data size at +0x11C, table/buffer at +0x128. NetworkAudioReceiver (0x00563410) is a TCP/UDP/alternate mode state machine over a socket at +0x88 with an optional RC4/XOR decrypt path. SystemCapabilitiesInfo (0x0055F080, 0x0055F0D0) is inferred (GUESS) from the shared RenderUISystemGlobalInit caller and overlapping offsets: performance tier at +0x0, MHz at +0x28, memory stats at +0x7C..+0x90, feature flags at +0x9C. PathNameResolver (0x005626B0, 0x00562830, 0x00562890, 0x005628F0) is four near-identical 1400-byte stack-buffer builders differing only in the indirect handler slot. VertexProjectionUpdater (0x005613E0) and ConfigKeyLookupParser (0x00565400) are single-function GUESS classes. Remaining functions keep UNKNOWN owners. The packet's large read-only global tables (jump tables, doubles, dword/word/byte tables around 0x5DC47C) and non-canonical 0xFF00.. MMX/3DNow artifacts are folded into unresolved evidence.

function_roles.role: Zeroes the base structure via GlobalZeroInit_c2a0 then explicitly clears fifteen heterogeneous fields (DWORD +0x0; BYTEs +0x4/+0x2C/+0x54; DWORDs +0x24/+0x28/+0x4C/+0x50/+0x74/+0x78/+0x7C/+0x80/+0x94/+0x98/+0x9C); returns this. Constructor-style initializer invoked by RenderUISystemGlobalInit and sub_556260 during render/UI global init.

CPU/system capability detection and benchmark: GetSystemInfo/CPUID/GetPriorityClass benchmark, vendor-specific (Intel/AMD/Cyrix) CPU name and tier/feature-flag assignment, GlobalMemoryStatus memory totals, and optional hand-off of name plus +0x94/+0x98 fields to sub_55BE20. Invoked by RenderUISystemGlobalInit.
Cube map texture struct initializer: bulk-zeros the object, strcpy's the aCubemas410 filename constant onto the base, then clears offsets 12/16/20 and 276-304. Returns this.

Loads a cube map MAS file: copies the filename to +0x14, opens via direct path then audio-entry directories (byte_8B5A3C/dword_8B8E30), validates a 12-byte magic against three constants, reads header fields, allocates payload = field@+0x118<<8 into +0x128, reads payload, bumps +0x11C by 24. Returns 0/-1/-2 on the error paths. Called by 0x0053CBC0.
Two-field resource cleanup: closes the +0x10 file handle and frees the +0x128 buffer, each null-guarded and zeroed after release. Always returns 0.

Looks up a filename in the packed resource table (256-byte entries at this+0x128, name at entry+20) and seeks the +0x10 handle to the entry data offset via sub_587F64. Stores matched index at +0x124. Returns 0 or -2.

Object initializer (thiscall): zero-init via GlobalZeroInit_c2a0, stamp float 0.2f at +0x0, clear scalar words, store a2 at +0x18 and a3 at +0x28, set state word +0x24 to 2, and link this into a2's child list (a2+312 deref, slot +560). Invoked by LinkedListNodeInsert_5930.
Sets the 32-bit state/flag field at +0x24 to 2, then calls the empty stub EmptyStub_0170. Runs during 3D sound source destruction.

Timed 3D-to-2D vertex projection update for the render tree: guards on status byte +0x24 bit 2 and render-state +0x18 flags, and on interval expiry (this+0x0 vs timer at +0x1C) walks the node tree, interpolates triangle vertices and projects them through vtable slot 4 of dword_8B8F24 into the +0x8 output buffer; otherwise resets the timer and rebuilds the node collection via RecursiveTreeNodeTraversal. Called by 0x005550E0.
Field cleanup helper: if the pointer at +0x1EC is non-null, free it via FreeWrapper_7bcf, pass the wrapper return through, and clear the field. Runs during SceneGraph cleanup.

Path/file-name helper (thiscall): builds a 1400-byte stack buffer seeded from byte_5EA438, invokes the callback held at this+0xC8 with (buffer, 1400, *(this+0x100)), and delegates composition to sub_562710. Called by FilePathNameLookup.

Variant of the stack-buffer path resolver that calls the handler pointer at a1+204 instead of this+0xC8; identical buffer build and sub_562710 delegation. One branch of FilePathNameLookup entry-table dispatch.

Variant of the stack-buffer path resolver that calls the handler pointer at a1+208 instead of this+0xC8; identical buffer build and sub_562710 delegation. One branch of FilePathNameLookup entry-table dispatch.

Variant of the stack-buffer path resolver that calls the handler pointer at a1+212 instead of this+0xC8; identical buffer build and sub_562710 delegation. One branch of FilePathNameLookup entry-table dispatch.

Polls a network socket and processes incoming audio-stream packets. State machine on the +0x0 mode field: case 1 TCP receiver (select/recv into byte_8CF288/dword_8CFAE0, XOR/RC4 decrypt, 6-byte header parse, audio note/param dispatch), case 2 UDP receiver (select/recvfrom, port dispatch), case 3 alternate handler. Closes and resets +0x88 on failure/timeout/end-of-stream and notifies AudioValueSetterCall.

Three-state path-segment processor driven by the state field at a1+1460: state 0 validates and counts path segments (dword_8CFA88), state 1 extracts each segment, runs it through the a1+148 callback and stores results in dword_8CFA90, state 2 runs QueryWithContextCleanup and the a1+120 final callback. Invoked by receiveAudioStreamPacket.
Forwarding thunk (__stdcall): passes a1 straight through to the real implementation and returns its result. On the frame path, called only by 0x00565520.

Parses a dot-delimited config key path: copies the string at this+0x198 onto the object base, tokenizes at the '.' delimiter (asc_5C30AC), walks matching segments against a2 via sub_588410, finishes with a word_5C32D8 segment. Returns 0/1. Called by five config-key consumers.

Linked-list destructor with per-node sub-object cleanup: walks the list from *a1, and when the node+8 flag is set frees data and its sub-resource at data+0x144; frees every node; zeroes the four list-head dwords and returns the last FreeWrapper result.

thiscall factory: allocates a 548-byte object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, default-initializes leading fields and a -1 sentinel at offset 532, stores the pointer into *this (0 on allocation failure). Callers span resource cleanup, file enumeration, profile loading, and texture scanning.

classes.name: CubeMapMasFileLoader
classes.responsibility: Cube-map MAS file resource object: constructor-style init, file open/validate/read, resource-table filename lookup/seek, and dual-field cleanup. Layout shared across four functions: magic/header at base, file handle at +0x10, filename at +0x14, entry count at +0x118, data size at +0x11C, matched index at +0x124, table/data buffer at +0x128.

classes.name: NetworkAudioReceiver
classes.responsibility: Receives streaming audio over a network socket. Mode field at +0x0 selects TCP (select/recv/decrypt/parse), UDP (select/recvfrom/port dispatch), or an alternate handler. Shares the byte_8CF288/dword_8CFAE0 receive buffer with the audio system and notifies AudioValueSetterCall on stream end or failure.

classes.name: SystemCapabilitiesInfo
classes.responsibility: System capability/output structure produced by CPU detection and used by render/UI global init. Performance tier at +0x0, MHz at +0x28, memory stats at +0x7C..+0x90, feature flags at +0x9C. GUESS: ownership inferred only from the shared RenderUISystemGlobalInit caller and overlapping field offsets between zeroInitStruct and CPUDetectionAndBenchmark.

classes.name: PathNameResolver
classes.responsibility: Resolves file paths by building a 1400-byte stack buffer (first byte from byte_5EA438, rest zeroed), populating it through an object-held handler pointer, and composing the result via sub_562710. Four entry points differ only in the handler slot used (this+0xC8 or a1+204/+208/+212). GUESS: grouped by identical shape; the owning object type is unproven.

classes.name: VertexProjectionUpdater
classes.responsibility: Timed render-tree vertex projection: interval at +0x0, emitted-vertex counter at +0x4, output buffer at +0x8, render-tree node at +0xC, render-state object at +0x18, high-precision timer at +0x1C, vertex buffer at +0x20, status byte at +0x24. Projects interpolated triangle vertices through vtable slot 4 of the dword_8B8F24 object. GUESS: single function, owner unproven.

classes.name: ConfigKeyLookupParser
classes.responsibility: Parses a dot-delimited config key path on the object buffer: source string at +0x198, current token pointer at +0x180. Tokenizes at the '.' delimiter and matches segments against a caller-supplied key. GUESS: single function; the owning config object is unproven.

state_machines.name: NetworkAudioReceiverModeDispatch
transitions: mode==1 -> TCP: select + recv into byte_8CF288, optional XOR/RC4 decrypt, parse packets and dispatch; on recv error/close -> closesocket, socket=-1, AudioValueSetterCall, return 3
mode==2 -> UDP: select + recvfrom, validate against aFinal marker, ntohs port dispatch; on 3s inactivity timeout -> closesocket, socket=-1, AudioValueSetterCall, return 0
mode==3 -> delegate to alternate receiver handler and return its result

state_machines.name: PathProcessorStateMachine
transitions: state 0 -> validate backslash count, set dword_8CFA88 entry count, clear dword_8CFA90, advance to state 1
state 1 -> per segment: extract, malloc-copy, run a1+148 callback, store result in first free dword_8CFA90 slot; when the array fills, advance to state 2
state 2 -> re-count, run QueryWithContextCleanup, append backslash, invoke the a1+120 final callback
invalid state or count threshold exceeded -> return -1

interfaces.name: PathResolverCallback
interfaces.purpose: Populates a 1400-byte stack buffer (first byte seeded from byte_5EA438, remaining zeroed) given (buffer, 1400, per-object argument at +0x100); the populated buffer is then composed into the final path by sub_562710. Implemented via object-held handler slots at this+0xC8 or a1+204/+208/+212.

interfaces.name: CubeMapMasFileFormat
interfaces.purpose: Contract for reading cube-map MAS files: 12-byte magic that must match one of three constants (aCubemas410/400/401), three 4-byte header fields, payload size derived as field@+0x118 << 8, buffer allocation and threaded reads, handle closed and logged on any error. Filename fallback searches registered audio entry directories.

compatibility_contracts.name: CubeMapMasFileLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must read cube-map MAS files whose first 12 bytes match one of three magic constants (0x005DBC08/0x005DBBF0/0x005DBBFC), followed by three 4-byte header fields (targets +0x114/+0x118/+0x120); the payload size is field@+0x118 << 8 and the payload is allocated and read into +0x128; the stored size at +0x11C is then inflated by 24. Open failure at the direct path falls back to '%s\%s' candidates over registered audio entry directories and returns -2 when all fail.

compatibility_contracts.name: NetworkAudioStreamWireProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must receive audio-stream packets on a socket: TCP mode recv's into the shared 2047-byte buffer byte_8CF288 and parses 6-byte headers (packet id dword + subtype word swapped with ntohs), dispatching through audio note/param search; an optional per-byte XOR/RC4 decrypt is keyed by an object string and the +0x55C encryption flag. Packets are delimited by the 7-byte aFinal marker (0x005E4EAC). UDP mode recvfrom's up to 1499 bytes and dispatches by ntohs source port.

compatibility_contracts.name: ResourceEntryTableLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable that reads the packed resource table must lay out 256-byte entries starting at this+0x128 with the entry name at entry+20 and the data offset at entry+4; entry count is at this+0x118 and the matched index is stored at +0x124, after which the +0x10 file handle is seeked to the entry data offset (this+0x11C + *(entry+4)).

compatibility_contracts.name: PathResolutionStackBufferContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must preserve the path-resolution helper ABI: a 1400-byte stack buffer whose first byte is seeded from byte_5EA438 and whose remaining bytes are zeroed is passed to an object-held handler as (buffer, 1400, argument at +0x100); the handler populates the buffer and sub_562710 composes the final path.

unresolved: Owners of most objects are UNKNOWN: only CubeMapMasFileLoader and NetworkAudioReceiver are DERIVED from packet evidence; SystemCapabilitiesInfo, PathNameResolver, VertexProjectionUpdater and ConfigKeyLookupParser are GUESS groupings and could be wrong.

SystemCapabilitiesInfo merges zeroInitStruct (0x0055F080) and CPUDetectionAndBenchmark (0x0055F0D0) on the strength of the shared RenderUISystemGlobalInit caller and overlapping offsets (+0x0, +0x24, +0x28, +0x7C, +0x80, +0x94, +0x98, +0x9C). The packet does not prove common ownership; equal offsets from different bases were not merged elsewhere.
GlobalZeroInit_c2a0 bulk-zeroing plus explicit field writes in zeroInitStruct and cubeMapTextureInit is redundant unless the structures are partially reused; purpose unknown.

Meaning of the three 4-byte MAS header fields (only +0x118 feeds the data-size computation; +0x114 and +0x120 are read but unrepresented as packet fields) and the trailing +24 adjustment to +0x11C are unknown.

The resource-table entry layout (256-byte stride, name at +20, data offset at +4) is inferred from the raw source only and not individually flagged; this+0x12C is listed as accessed but never read or written in FilenameLookupAndSeek.

EmptyStub_0170 (0x00560C00), EmptyStub_7470 and EmptyStubWithFlagCheck (CPU detection) have no in-packet callee addresses; MilesSoundSystemStreamVolumeSet (0x00406659) is listed as a callee of receiveAudioStreamPacket but no call appears in its body.
Case 3 of receiveAudioStreamPacket delegates to sub_563AB0, which has no packet evidence reference; its identity and return contract are unknown.
The XOR key string at this+44 and the RC4 key-schedule buffer at this+156 are mentioned in operation prose but are not in the packet field evidence, so only the +0x55C encryption flag is bound.
The multistatePathProcessor object (state at +1460, callbacks at +120/+148, context at +144/+124) is unidentified and has no packet-listed fields.
The byte_8CF288 first-byte XOR 0xEC marker and aFinal frame-delimiter semantics are DERIVED from branch structure, not proven.
The PathNameResolver handler slots at a1+204/+208/+212 and the value at a1+256 are not packet field evidence; whether a1 is a vtable-backed object or a plain function-pointer table is unverified.

The float defaults (0.2f at +0x0 of ObjectInitWithParameterLinking; 0.050000001 blend in TimedVertexProjectionUpdate) and the state literal 2 at +0x24 (linked-list child object and 3D-sound-source state flag) are semantic GUESSes not established by this packet.

The tier/feature semantics of CPUDetectionAndBenchmark (0-4, feature bits 1/3/5) are DERIVED from prior fill analysis, not the raw source; vendor string literals are inlined and their numeric global tables unknown.
The node+8 cleanup flag and data+0x144 sub-resource in EnhancedListCleanupWithSubObjectDelete are unknown; FreeWrapper_7bcf's return value meaning is unknown.
The 548-byte factory object from AllocateStructWithDefaultValues and its -1 sentinel at +532 are unidentified; the duplicate byte-zero write at +16 may be two booleans sharing the byte.

sub_565400 (real implementation behind the StringBasedLookup thunk) and the sub_588410/sub_5897CA match-test semantics are not described by this packet; word_5C32D8 as a 'HotExtension' context is DERIVED and unconfirmed.

The packet marks a large block of read-only globals (jump tables jpt_55F413/55F663/55F73F and neighbors, dword/word/byte tables 0x005DC47C..0x005DC5B4, doubles dbl_59E7D8/dbl_59EB50/dbl_5ADB68/dbl_5AF448) as read but they do not appear by name in the raw listing; Hex-Rays folded them into switch dispatch and inline constants.

Non-canonical 0xFF0000000000541x/5429/543x addresses are MMX/3DNow register-file artifacts from inline asm (CPU detection) or jump-table artifacts near jpt_563421 (receiveAudioStreamPacket), not ordinary globals.

Global aSS_3 (0x005C2D64) appears in packet evidence for LoadCubeMapMasFile but is not visible in the raw source body; role of byte_5EA438 (seed byte) and this+0x8C/+0x90 duplicate memory stores is unknown.

A large block of read-only globals (jump tables jpt_55F413/55F663/55F73F and their byte neighbors, the dword/word/byte tables dword_5DC47C..byte_5DC590, doubles dbl_59E7D8/dbl_59EB50/dbl_5ADB68/dbl_5AF448, dword_8B8F24, and the MMX-style byte_FF0000000000541x/5429 registers) are packet-marked read but do not appear by name in the raw listing; Hex-Rays folded them into switch dispatch and inline constants.
The byte_FF0000000000541x/5429 addresses are rendered as fixed memory addresses by Hex-Rays and are likely MMX/3DNow register-file accesses from inline asm, not ordinary globals.
Exact semantics of this+0x24 (set to 1 on unsupported paths) and this+0x94/0x98 (dword indices 37/38 handed to sub_55BE20) are not confirmed in this packet.
The tier/feature semantics (0-4, bits 1/3/5) are DERIVED from the fill's existing analysis, not stated in the raw source.
Vendor string literals are rendered inline in the raw listing; the numeric global tables they alias are unknown.

Floats flt_59E43C and flt_59E448 are flagged as read by the packet but do not appear as named symbols in the decompiled body; they are likely consumed by inlined constant loads (e.g. the 0.050000001 blend factor) and their exact read site is unresolved.
The exact render-tree node layout behind this+0xC (index array, vertex base and per-node stride 48) is inferred from the loop arithmetic and not independently verified.
The object behind multistatePathProcessor a1 (state field at +1460, callback at +120, context values at +144 and +148) is not identified; the packet lists no fields for it.
The meaning of the globals dword_8CFA88 (entry count) and dword_8CFA90 (entry array) as a socket/entry collection is inferred from the state machine flow, not confirmed by independent evidence.
What QueryWithContextCleanup resolves and what the a1+120 callback consumes is not established beyond the argument shapes seen here.
The stack buffers v17 and v18 are NUL-terminated around the copied segments, but their exact role (path reconstruction) is inferred from the surrounding path calls.
